reviews.automation_rationale: Matching sessions to approved tickets is a rules-based comparison that could be scripted, with human follow-up on exceptions.
reviews.suggested_rewrite: Each month, within 10 business days after month-end, the IT Security Officer reviews the log of all SAP superuser and firefighter sessions, verifies each session against an approved ServiceNow ticket, and escalates any session without a ticket to the CIO within 2 business days. The signed log review is retained in ServiceNow.

span.text: SAP S/4HANA enforces the password parameters
minimum 12 characters, complexity rules, 90-day expiry and account lock after 5 failed attempts
At every logon
At every logon
The parameter settings are evidenced by a system parameter extract stored in the ITGC configuration baseline

reviews.automation_rationale: This is a system configuration enforced automatically; the baseline comparison could also be scripted.
reviews.suggested_rewrite: At every logon, SAP S/4HANA enforces the password parameters: minimum 12 characters, complexity rules, 90-day expiry and account lock after 5 failed attempts. After every SAP upgrade, the IT Security Officer compares a system parameter extract to the security standard. The extract is stored in the ITGC configuration baseline.
